data.name: Afiqah
data.gender_notes: Afiqah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has a vast knowledge and understanding, especially in religious matters. The name Afiqah carries the meaning “Knowledgeable, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Afiqah usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledgeable, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who is deeply spiritual and wise, with a thirst for knowledge and understanding
data.etymology: Afiqah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledgeable, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afiqah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أفقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: أفقة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصول عربية، يُشتق من الفعل أفق الذي يعني النمو والزيادة، وتُستخدم في اللغة العربية لوصف المرأة الصالحة والمتعلمة التي تتمتع بسمات الحكمة والتفكير العميق، ويعكس هذا الاسم القيم الروحية والعقلية في الإسلام، حيث تُعتبر المرأة المتعلمة والمثقفة أساس بناء المجتمع الصالح

in_urdu.name: عفقہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عفقہ ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے نیک اور تعلیم یافتہ خاتون، یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں ایک معزز مقام رکھتا ہے، जहاں عورت کی تعلیم اور تربیت کو بہت اہمیت دی جاتی ہے، اور یہ نام اس بات کی عکاسی کرتا ہے کہ کس طرح ایک تعلیم یافتہ خاتون اپنے گھر اور معاشرے میں ایک مثبت کردار ادا کر سکتی ہے

in_hindi.name: अफ़क़ा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अफ़क़ा एक इस्लामिक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है शिक्षित और सद्गुणी महिला, इस नाम का इस्लामी परंपरा में विशेष महत्व है, जहां महिला की शिक्षा और तरबियत को बहुत महत्व दिया जाता है, और यह नाम इस बात को दर्शाता है कि कैसे एक शिक्षित महिला अपने परिवार और समाज में एक सकारात्मक भूमिका निभा सकती है

in_pashto.name: افقه
in_pashto.meaning: د غورو او تعلیم یافته ښځه
in_pashto.long_meaning: افقه د یو اسلامی نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی، چې معنی یې ده د غورو او تعلیم یافته ښځه، دا نوم په اسلامی دود کې ځانګړی اهمیت لري، چېرې چې د ښځې تعلیم او تربیت ته ډېر اهمیت درکړل شوی، او دا نوم ښیي چې څنګه یو تعلیم یافته ښځه خپل کور او ټولنه کې یو सकارات्मक رول ولوبولی شي

in_english.name: Afiqah
in_english.long_meaning: Afiqah is an Islamic name derived from Arabic roots, meaning virtuous and educated woman, reflecting spiritual and intellectual values in Islam, where an educated woman is considered the foundation of a virtuous society, and this name highlights the importance of female education and moral character in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name "Afiqah" carries a noble and intellectually eloquent connotation. A person bearing this name is often perceived as an embodiment of knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment. In many Islamic cultures, academic achievements are highly valued, and the pursuit of knowledge is regarded as an essential aspect of personal growth and societal progress. Therefore, having a name like Afiqah, which signifies extensive and profound understanding, can elicit admiration, respect, and even awe from those around you.
data.spiritual_significance: The Islamic faith places immense importance on knowledge and understanding as key means to drawing closer to God (Allah). Afiqah as a name encapsulates this notion beautifully. Having a deep understanding and knowledge of religious teachings can lead to a more devout and spiritual life. The Quran verse 96:5 states: "And [mention] 'Ishaq [Ishmael] by the name of his father [Ibrahim], and [mention] him, Hamdan [Ishmael's son], and [mention] 'Al-Yas'in [Ishmael's given name], and, [O Muhammad], 'Al-Safa [Ishmael's wife, Sarah], and [mention] Shu'ayb [a prophet], and Maute [his son], and [mention] 'Ar-Rafiq [theis companions], and [mention] Online [another companion], and [mention] Harun [Aaron] and Harith [Aaron's son], and, when We appointed them as leaders, giving them the guidance and knowledge, [O Muhammad], and they believed with certainty in Our signs [that We had provided them].' (Translation from Sahih International)
data.spiritual_symbolism: Afiqah is an Arabic name meaning "understanding" or "comprehension of the divine truths." It is believed that those named Afiqah are blessed with the ability to deeply understand and internalize spiritual knowledge, guiding them on their spiritual journey.
